messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — spotted a pattern in today's test: enrichment delays are causing leads to bypass RR and hit fallback-owner path. Small thread to lock down a playbook for near-real-time enrichment gating.

oliver: Can you summarize the failure mode? is it TTL/queue backpressure or hubspot webhook lag?

maya: Mostly enrichment lambda taking >4s on peak. When enrichment >2s we lose the deterministic claim slot and code falls back to 'first-eligible' owner. Repro: 20% of leads in streak test.

sasha: Ugh. That's the reason SDRs were seeing skewed distribution this morning. We need a hard SLA for claim decision — otherwise RR fairness breaks.

jamal: Suggested approach: two-stage decision. 1) quick-pass (0-800ms): claim using enriched props if present. 2) slow-pass (800-2500ms): if enrichment not ready, assign minimal owner via lightweight heuristics then patch owner when enrichment arrives.

rachel: Would prefer explicit fallback that preserves round-robin position (mark as "placeholder-owner") so reporting doesn't count it as a real claim. Can we have a flag for downstream SF/HQ to ignore until enrichment confirmed?

maya: Yes — we can emit owner_state: placeholder and only set owner_final when enrichment_complete. That keeps allocation metrics intact.

jamal: Implementation sketch:
```
// pseudo-config for routing service
enrichment_gate: {
  max_fast_ms: 800,
  max_wait_ms: 2500,
  fallback_policy: "placeholder_owner",
  placeholder_ttl_s: 300
}
```
This uses existing heartbeat key so placeholder expires if no enrichment.

oliver: What SLA on HubSpot/SF sync? if placeholder owner set, do we still create contact/lead in HS right away?

maya: Yes create lead in HS immediately with owner_state: placeholder. Add custom field `redwood_enrichment_status` to track. hubspot-bot will update when enrichment webhook arrives.

hubspot-bot: Noted. Will surface `redwood_enrichment_status` change events to #marketing and #sales-ops.

sasha: Two asks: 1) metric to surface % placeholder-to-finalized conversions, 2) alert when placeholder rate > 10% for >15m.

jamal: We'll add a Prometheus metric `lead_placeholder_ratio` and an alert rule. Quick rule: `placeholder_ratio > 0.1 for 15m` triggers paging to revops oncall.

rachel: Also add a reporting flag so weekly ownership reports exclude placeholders from SDR performance.

maya: Operational runbook (short):
- If placeholder spikes: run enrichment backfill job for leads in last 30m.
- If hubspot webhook backlog: escalate to infra (queue depth > 500 => page).
- If placeholder persists after 24h: run manual reconciliation and notify sales leadership.

jamal: I'll draft the implementation PR for routing-service + small HS mapping change. ETA tomorrow afternoon.

oliver: Can marketing/docs get a blurb for the handoff playbook so CSMs know placeholder semantics?

maya: Yep — I'll write a 1-pager and link it in the playbook.

sasha: :thumbsup: thanks all. Good compromise.

maya: Assigning follow-ups: jamal -> implement gate + metric, maya -> playbook + HS field, oliver -> define alert thresholds with SRE, rachel -> reporting rules. I'll open the playbook doc and ping folks.
